# SmallDocs developer documentation

SmallDocs renders agent-authored Markdown and rich documents inside web applications.

## SDK integration

- [Complete integration guide](https://smalldocs.org/developers/integration.md): Single-page SDK contract.
- [Overview](https://smalldocs.org/developers/overview.md): Renderer boundary and data flow.
- [Quickstart](https://smalldocs.org/developers/quickstart.md): Smallest browser integration.
- [Document content](https://smalldocs.org/developers/content.md): Feature discovery and mixed documents.
- [Lifecycle](https://smalldocs.org/developers/lifecycle.md): Render, update, destroy, and multiple instances.
- [Security](https://smalldocs.org/developers/security.md): Browser, network, and CSP boundaries.
- [Loading](https://smalldocs.org/developers/loading.md): Caching and content-driven dependencies.
- [Browser API](https://smalldocs.org/developers/api.md): Experimental 0.1.0 contract.

## Authoring SmallDocs Markdown

- [Markdown and navigation](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/markdown.md)
- [Code](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/code.md)
- [Math](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/math.md)
- [Mermaid diagrams](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/diagrams.md)
- [Charts](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/charts.md)
- [Computed cells](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/cells.md)
- [Slides](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/slides.md)
- [Custom slide shapes](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/slide-shapes.md)
- [Video](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/video.md)
- [Styles](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/styles.md)

- [Agent integration](https://smalldocs.org/developers/agents.md)

- [Renderer integration skill](https://smalldocs.org/.well-known/agent-skills/smalldocs-renderer/SKILL.md)
- [Document authoring skill](https://smalldocs.org/.well-known/agent-skills/smalldocs-author/SKILL.md)

## Install

`npx skills add https://smalldocs.org --skill smalldocs-renderer`

`npx skills add https://smalldocs.org --skill smalldocs-author`
